docs.title: Read-only native source evidence
docs.text:
Root: <FontLab C++ source checkout> (FontLab Ltd. internal, read-only).

  • Proteus/common/model/flshape.cpp:4635–4639 delegates clearContours to shapeData; flshapedata.cpp:3247–3261 clears contours without marking changed.
  • flshape.cpp:520–547 changes the transform property; explicitly marking the shape changed makes the owning shape participate in the history request.
  • Proteus/pygate/pyflobject.cpp:313–317 binds historyStates/currentHistoryState. Proteus/common/controllers/flhistorycontroller.cpp:2145–2165 walks glyph, layer, shape and shapeData indices; package-only history omits glyph edits.
  • Proteus/pygate/pyflitems.cpp:134–159 maps a notification list to native objects. Glyph mutation now sends the same [layer, glyph] list before editing and in finally afterwards, including partially failing mutations.

The requested round-12 review file could not be located in the workspace reviews directory or WORK.md. All four explicit review instructions in the Round-13 brief are implemented: closing notification finally, pending-point lifecycle boundaries, an all-offcurve closed contour regression, and key-master scope.

docs.title: Round 14: geometry history and independent Undo evidence
docs.text: C4 measurements on 94b266a refute the previous geometry Undo claim. Round 13's changed flags alone do not protect shape references retained by native history. This round implements the existing, natively measured Glyport copy-on-write protocol, but Fontport's result still needs C4 verification. No native session was run by this host-free lane. Round 13 was landed by the controller as e2ca6ec; these changes are on top and are not committed by this lane.

docs.title: T10: protected shapes, two explicit history rows
docs.text:
After the pre-change [layer, glyph] notification, clone each working shape and replace it at the same layer index. Mutate only the clones, then send the same notification list in finally. The flLayer/flGlyph objects remain the same; their history keeps the old shapes. Shape style and transforms are cloned; other layers and layer-level hints are not replaced. Hinted/shared/transformed outline cases retain their pre-write refusals.

The two notifications produce a measured extra no-op checkpoint. Fontport exposes this as glyph.exactSingleUndo: supported=False, rather than claiming one row. Driver receipts retain one_history_row, accept only one or two rows, and name glyph.exactSingleUndo when two appear. The FIRST Undo must restore geometry. For a two-row edit the second Undo must leave that baseline unchanged; Redo of the checkpoint must also leave it unchanged, then Redo of the edit restores the edited geometry. More rows or any geometry mismatch fail the suite.

Read-only source root: <FontLab C++ source checkout> (FontLab Ltd. internal, read-only).

  • Proteus/common/model/fllayer.cpp:1393–1430 initializes shape histories and adds shape objects to history-state storage; those references must remain intact.
  • flshape.cpp:2173–2233 clones shapeData, transform and style; clone() delegates to cloneCustom(cloneAll). fllayer.cpp:9546–9566 exposes insertShape/removeShape.
  • flobject.cpp:2816–2850 restores stored history records. Package initialization at flpackage.cpp:14377–14396 covers package containers, not a deep geometry copy.
  • Proteus/pygate/pyflitems.cpp:134–159 maps notifyChangesApplied's object list; pre/post notification alone cannot isolate mutable shape data.
  • Existing Python route: fontlab-glyport/src/fontlab_glyport/model/ fontlab_backend.py:1559–1604 (_prepare/_own_shape).
  • Native evidence: workspace verification/issue-101-ecosystem/evidence/ glyport-model/probe_undo_first_edit.json (pre-notify gives a restoring Undo plus a no-op row), and glyport-matrix/probe_undo_cloned_shape.json (in-place mutation never restores; clone restores on first Undo). These contradict the suggestion that mutating the original shape protects its saved snapshot.

docs.title: T22: independent MCP geometry oracle
docs.text: Every baseline/read uses a fresh fontpr get_glyph call, detached with deepcopy. Before editing, freeze a JSON geometry record from every layer's elements (including contour node/point data and component transforms). Undo/Redo receipts include expected/observed geometry strings, SHA-256 hashes and geometry_equal. False geometry_equal fails even when equal is true. Required geometry edits must also actually change this record, preventing a no-op from passing restoration. Raw MCP payloads remain in receipts. Only the documented bare empty-shape and layer-active UI equivalences are applied. Unit tests deliberately corrupt node coordinates and prove the receipt is retained as a failure.

docs.title: T21 and structured scope
docs.text:
Native writes that cannot satisfy UFO per-side kerning membership refuse as groups.multiMembership before any checkpoint or write. Detached generic groups still raise their usual validation error. The both-sided native refusal probe creates an owned glyph with no pre-existing class membership and tests divergent sides using an empty side; it no longer corrupts A's memberships on plum.

Panose, weight/width and H/V stem snaps retain key-master default semantics. Both capabilities() and STRUCTURED_ROUTES expose bound: key-master for each. Per-master writes were not added: only the current key-master write routes have C4 Undo/Redo/VFJ proof. The catalogue does not imply all-master writes.

docs.title: C4 commands
docs.text:
Run in fresh sessions using the shared wrapper; fixtures and outputs are owned. The wrapper locates the workspace and handles the mutating-session policy. Each edit/action/read/checkpoint is a separate call under the existing 4-second gate. Owned fonts close with save=False in cleanup.

sh tests/native_drivers/run-round10.sh --suite glyph
sh tests/native_drivers/run-round10.sh --suite pens
sh tests/native_drivers/run-round10.sh --suite boundaries

Repeat all three with --fixture and an absolute GetGo cc0/plum/plum-var.vfj path; the default is cc0/medi/medi.vfj. Glyph now covers edit_glyph, live getPen, appendPoint, width, clearContours, component add/transform, and hinted refusal. Pens must prove rounded flatten geometry restores. Boundaries must prove no multi-membership setup exception and key-master scope in capability receipts. Re-run the seven suites and attached upstream as a regression sweep; append --dry-run to validate startup without host contact.

docs.title: Round 15: driver-only comparison corrections
docs.text:
Input: workspace verification/issue-106/evidence/issue-105/round14/SUMMARY.md. C4 verified native geometry restoration on f3d7dc5, including the named extra no-op row. This round changes only driver oracles and their tests/docs.

  • T23: glyph_receipt compares upstream point-pen digests, numeric metric values, Unicode lists, lib and anchor dictionaries directly, without serialization or numeric tolerance. Only None/absent and empty notes are equivalent, disclosed as fontlab.note.empty. fontlab.numericValue documents value equality (0 equals 0.0). Raw expected/observed values, digests and anchors remain in receipts.
  • T24: glyph-create explicitly selects package history (currentHistoryState and historyStates); later mutations select glyph history. Receipts record scope. Creation Undo/Redo/reopen still compare complete payloads and frozen geometry.
  • T25: fontlab.lastModified excludes the root MCP save/edit timestamp from read equality. Raw timestamps remain in expected/observed receipts. No nested lib key is removed. Other metadata, outlines and metrics remain significant.

Regression probes change an outline point, width, height, nonempty note and a nested lastModified lib value; each must fail equality. Creation receipts are exercised with package rows present and glyph history inaccessible, proving the scope switch rather than merely testing the helper in isolation.

C4 re-runs (each wrapper command uses an owned fixture/session):

sh tests/native_drivers/run-round10.sh --suite glyph
sh tests/native_drivers/run-round10.sh --suite interchange

Repeat glyph with --fixture and an absolute GetGo cc0/plum/plum-var.vfj path; repeat interchange with absolute paths to cc0/plum/plum-var.vfj and apache/zotosans/zotosans-georgian.vfj. Medio is the default. Expect no false creation-history, timestamp, empty-note or numeric-type failures, while geometry Undo/Redo/reopen and import/export comparisons remain mandatory. Every phase retains the existing time limit and size-framed transfer. Append --dry-run for host-free wrapper validation. The remaining suites are regression checks.

docs.title: Whole-font UFO interchange
docs.text:
ExportSession(backend).steps() reads every named layer/glyph, then supported info, groups, kerning, lib and feature text using real ufoLib2. Exhaust steps before save(absolute_ufo_path), which refuses overwrite. Inside FontLab use the round10 native controller: it transfers one GLIF/metadata unit at a time and saves the assembled UFO externally. .losses records native exclusions and invalid native info values. The borrowed source is never edited or closed.

ImportSession(source, native=True).preflight_steps() first detaches/checks one glyph per step, then metadata. Only after exhaustion can .begin(factory) allocate a new native backend and return (font, steps). Advance once per RPC; close the owned font in finally. Outside the fixed host deadline, the convenience with import_native(ufo) as (font, steps): exhausts preflight and closes on exit. import_ufo(ufo, backend_factory) offers the same protocol for a caller-supplied backend. The host-free UFOBackend is explicitly a test/storage backend.

New-native import explicitly opts into the legacy info-history/group routes because this is a newly constructed owned document, not an editor batch. This does not promise one Undo row or restore legacy flags omitted by UFO conversion. Ordinary editor setters retain v1.0.0 defaults under D18; strict checks are opt-in.

Import creates component bases before assigning outlines/components. Preflight refuses missing/cyclic bases, unsupported layer topology, Unicode native names, fractional native anchors/kerning, unsupported anchor metadata/guidelines/images, non-JSON native lib values and feature code that cannot survive native history. No native destination exists when these checks refuse. Unexpected apply failures are not a native transaction; the owned partially constructed font is discarded.

Field Host-free UFO round trip Native mapping / loss Layer names/default layer, all glyph names Preserved Export reads every layer. Import currently accepts only one layer and maps it to the new native default master. Multiple native layers/masters refuse before allocation Contours, on/off curves, smooth flags Preserved Read through native shape transforms; plain unhinted shape writes only. Original shape partition/style/transform identity is not retained Components and affine matrices Preserved Exported by base name. New native import creates bases first. Existing component replacement/removal in a live document refuses Width, height, unicodes, note, glyph lib Preserved Native Unicode/note/lib are glyph-global, not independent UFO-layer metadata; widths/outlines/anchors are layer-specific. Non-ASCII glyph names refuse native writes Anchors Fractional positions/names preserved Integral named positions supported; fractions, color, identifier and unnamed anchors refuse native import/write Guidelines (glyph/font) Glyph guidelines preserved in UFOBackend tests Native layer/font guidelines are not exported. Native writes/import refuse guidelines. Export therefore lists this loss Glyph/layer colors, identifiers, image data, image transforms Not a tested whole-backend field Native read adapter does not expose them; images and unsupported anchor metadata refuse import. Native image bytes are not exported Kerning, explicit zeros, groups Preserved Current-key-master mapping only; other masters' pairs/classes, key glyphs and legacy flags are not represented. Fractions and divergent native both-sided memberships refuse writes Features Exact text retained VFJ-canonical prefix/ordered blocks exported. Reserved lib key org.fontlab.fontport.featureBlocks retains exact native boundaries for import; a pre-existing collision refuses. This extra interchange entry is removed on import OT class definitions Groups retained independently Class declarations are not injected into feature text, avoiding duplication. Use recipes.parse_features(..., classes=groups) for feaLib. UFO consumers requiring inline classes must combine them deliberately Info INFO_FIELDS retained Exact list: info.INFO_FIELDS. Other UFO info attributes are outside the native adapter. Invalid native UFO values (e.g. empty Panose/width class 0) become absent and get individual loss entries Optional absent info Retained with UFOBackend Native concrete double metrics cannot be unset; absent UFO metrics remain native defaults on import, not a promise of absence. No invented zero is written Font lib Nested plist values retained Foreign JSON null/non-plist values refuse export serialization; native imports accept the documented JSON subset only. Unknown lib leaves are never silently filtered UPM and coordinate scale Values retained No rescaling is implied by changing UPM Axes, mappings, instances, interpolation state Not a UFO-font field designspace_io.export_designspace (issue 201) writes a .designspace and one UFO per master from the native layers and Designspace.from_native. Kerning is read per master (flPackage.kerning(master)) and written to each master UFO; rules, labels, per-master groups/info/features and brace layers are not read (designspace_io.LOSSES). Import: native_import.import_designspace (below) Hints/TT programs, masks, native metrics links, zones, shape sharing/styles/builders, audit/UI/selection/history/export state Not represented Native-only data has no implementation here. Live edits preserve untouched native state; a UFO/new-native round trip cannot reconstruct it Glyph/layer order beyond backend enumeration Not a native-order restoration contract Layer enumeration and glyph order are exposed; native reordering is unavailable

docs.title: Native UFO and designspace routes (task 17, measured on FontLab 9)
docs.text:
Owned copies, closed with save=False; probe in the workspace scratch.

  • MCP save_font writes only .vfj, .vfc or .vfjp; it has no UFO route.
  • fgFont.save("x.ufo") is lossy, which is why ExportSession stays the UFO and designspace exporter: it writes the current master only (a 3-master font gave one glyphs layer), no kerning.plist (64 source pairs), and no anchors (0 glifs, 348 anchor blocks in the source VFJ). It does write fontinfo, groups, lib, features and metainfo.
  • open_font("x.ufo") returns ok and imports the glyphs as one master.
  • open_font("x.designspace") with one Weight axis and two sources imported both masters and the axis as one font. Kerning and anchor import were not checked (the probe UFOs had none).

import_ufo_native(path) and import_designspace(path) call the same NativeApplication.open_font (fontpr.call("open_font", path=...)) and return an owned NativeFontBackend. They refuse a wrong suffix, a missing file or a relative path, and convert nothing, so no Fontport loss list applies.

These are a bounded conversion and an explicit inventory, not a lossless native font archive. Use VFJ for that purpose. Full multilevel native guidelines, native layer creation and variable metadata interchange remain open; C4 should return reopened UFO/VFJ comparisons for the Latin, variable and non-Latin fixtures.

Round-15 native comparison contract: absent/None and empty notes are equivalent (fontlab.note.empty), and numeric values compare numerically without tolerance (fontlab.numericValue). Raw values and point-pen digests are retained in native receipts. Real metric, outline, nonempty note, lib and anchor differences fail.
